subject: Orchard Health: Launch rollcall + first-week bridge & agenda
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Claire Morgan <claire@orchardhealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj@orchardhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orchard Health: Launch rollcall + first-week bridge & agenda

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We want to lock the Week 0/Week 1 rollcall so your stakeholders have clear owners and the bridge is set. Proposed details below — please confirm the best time and final attendee list so I can send the calendar invite.

Proposed kickoff (Week 0)
- Date: Tue, Jul 20 — 10:00–11:00 PT (we can shift to 13:00 PT if that helps APAC attendees)
- Bridge: Zoom (link TBD) + calendar invite
- Goal: finalize responsibilities, admin access, and onboarding prework completion

Suggested agenda (30–45 mins)
- 10m introductions & success criteria (Redwood + Orchard)
- 15m deployment plan & access checklist (who needs R/W, SSO owners, IP allow-lists)
- 10m integration touchpoints (API keys, data flow, staging prod cutover)
- 10m next steps & scheduling of technical deep-dive

Attendee ask (please confirm names/roles):
- Product sponsor (Orchard)
- IT / network security (Orchard)
- 1x PM / workflow owner (Orchard)
- Redwood owners: Evelyn Hart (CS), Ben Carter (Onboarding), Jordan Blake (Implementation)

Attachments: I’ve attached the Implementation Role Matrix and the onboarding prework checklist.

If the above works I’ll follow with a calendar invite that includes the Zoom link, doc links, and a small prework packet.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: Implementation_Role_Matrix.xlsx, Orchard_Onboarding_Prework.pdf

- We routed the PO through procurement this morning; I’ll send a DocuSign link after approval and can share the scanned PO (if helpful).

Appreciate the prework — I’ll confirm final compliance attendee by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Claire
